_help: Which marks a hit leaves on your screen.
Rule conditions. Leave one out to match anything; a list matches any of its entries.
damage:   damage type, such as mob, player, arrow, cactus, fall, drown, onFire, lava, magic, wither, or a modded type.
entity:   what hit you directly: the mob in melee, the arrow or fireball for ranged attacks.
attacker: who is responsible: the mob in melee, the skeleton that shot the arrow, the witch that threw the potion.
For entity and attacker: a registered entity name (Zombie also covers subclasses such as PigZombie),
Player, a full class name, @living, @projectile, or @none.
weapon:   the item held by what hit you in melee. An item name such as minecraft:iron_sword, or @sword, @axe,
@pickaxe, @shovel, @hoe, @bow, @arrow, @any, or @none for empty hands.
projectile, fire, explosion, magic, unblockable, absolute: true or false to require that property of the damage.
These catch modded damage too, whatever its type is called.
When several rules match, the most specific one wins: a rule that checks more things beats one that checks fewer,
an exact entity or item beats a group such as @sword or @living, and a subclass beats its parent.
Ties go to the rule listed first. So { damage: magic, attacker: Witch } beats { magic: true }.
Rule results:
mark:   a set of marks from below, or none for no marks at all.
color:  RRGGBB tint. Without it, blood marks use the bloodColor setting and other marks their own color.
amount: multiplier for the number of marks (one per point of damage). max: most marks from one hit.
Marks are texture folders, assets/sonicvisuals/DefaultTheme/visuals/Splat/<name>, listed in visuals.txt, so
resource packs can add new ones. Blood marks use the blood color and count toward persistent blood.
size: smallest and largest size as a fraction of the screen. stretch: width to height ratio. life: ticks on screen.
/evtest log prints every hit's damage type, entity, attacker, weapon and the mark it got.
Changes apply after F3+T or /evtest reload.
